headline: Prithvi Vachani appointed Executive Director for 5 years
why: Board addition of current VP who led key IT hardware expansions and major partnerships like Asus and HP.

people.name: Prithvi Vachani
people.background: Served as Vice President at Dixon Technologies. 2017 graduate of Bentley University. Orchestrated collaboration with boAt for twin wireless speakers, spearheaded Chennai facility setup, and drove IT hardware division growth via partnerships with Asus and HP.
